acceptance_criteria.criterion: When capture_dialogues=True, write_dialogue() is called after each ainvoke() with the full messages list
When capture_dialogues=False or unset, write_dialogue() is never called
Ledger slug directory is correctly derived from workspace_root and project_path
dialogue_captured event is emitted via run_logger.stream_entry() with fields: stage, wp_id, filename, revision, level='INFO'
The event entry is appended to extra_log_entries (or equivalent) so it appears in run_log
_build_stream_console_line() formats dialogue_captured events as: '{prefix} {wp_id} dialogue saved → {filename}'
jsonl-log-schema.md has a row for dialogue_captured in the Action Values table
jsonl-log-schema.md documents filename, revision, and path fields
Unit tests verify capture is called when flag is True and skipped when False
